faqs.question: How do I book a class?
faqs.answer: Message us on WhatsApp to ask about available classes and how to book.
faqs.message: Hello Aarav Yoga! I would like to book a yoga class. Can you share the available options?

faqs.question: Can beginners join?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Private Yoga and Group Yoga Classes include basic options. Message us to find a suitable starting point.
faqs.message: Hello Aarav Yoga! I am a beginner. Which class would you recommend?

faqs.question: What are the timings and fees?
faqs.answer: Please contact us for the current timetable, class fees, and package details.
faqs.message: Hello Aarav Yoga! Could you share your class timings and fees?

faqs.question: Where is the studio?
faqs.answer: We have four studios in Noida and Greater Noida: Jaypee Greens, ATS Pristine (Sector 150), Aanad Ashray (Phi II), and Purvanchal Royal City (Chi V). Find addresses and map links on our Contact page.
